questions.text: When you think about moments of shame in your life, do any specific memories come to mind that still feel heavy?
questions.verse_text: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

questions.text: Have you ever felt like your past mistakes define who you are?
questions.verse_text: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

questions.text: Is there something you've never told anyone because you were afraid of how they'd see you?
questions.verse_text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
follow_up_hints: Point to safe confession to God

questions.text: How has shame affected the way you see yourself in God's eyes?
questions.verse_text: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

questions.text: Do you sometimes hide parts of yourself from God, even though you know He sees everything?
questions.verse_text: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

questions.text: What would change in your life if you truly believed God holds nothing against you?
questions.verse_text: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.

questions.text: Can you remember a time when you felt truly forgiven and free? What was that like?
questions.verse_text: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

questions.text: Mary Magdalene was publicly known for her past, yet Jesus chose her. How does knowing that affect you?
questions.verse_text: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils.

questions.text: If Jesus were sitting with you right now, what do you think He would say about the shame you carry?
questions.verse_text: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
follow_up_hints: Jesus's actual words to the shamed

questions.text: Are there lies about yourself that shame has made you believe? What are they?
questions.verse_text: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
follow_up_hints: Shame is not the final word
